_what: Brief 5 T4 gate, step 1: recalibrate the density cost model from the D4-measured per-tree/per-pass rates (BACKLOG 2026-09-22). The 0.100 ms/1000 rate is withdrawn.

recalibrated_caps._method: slope_per_unit_m = measured_ms_per_1000 * v3_in_frustum/1000; cap = 1 + (line - margin - hold)/slope

open_max._note: binding station, new (no v3 baseline). Measured 14.151 ms at 4943 in-frustum trees, OVER 13.0 by 1.151. To get under 13.0 needs ~1348 fewer in-frustum trees at the 0.854 ms/1000 rate.

headline: At the TRUE measured per-tree cost the affordable density collapses: forest_floor cap 2.38 -> 1.162, plaza 5.48 -> 2.157. Without cutting the per-tree cost, the density upgrade is nearly dead at forest_floor (~1.16x).

t4_addressability._what: Which of the measured passes T4 LOD rungs (mesh tri-reduction on the NON-Nanite species: ConiferPine, SpruceSub, SpruceSapling) can actually reduce.
t4_addressability.NaniteVisBuffer_2.200: NOT ADDRESSABLE by T4 — this is the Conifer (Nanite) raster; Nanite manages its own LODs (derived_ladder: Conifer SINGLE-REPRESENTATION). T4 rungs do not touch it.
t4_addressability.LumenReflections_1.303: NOT ADDRESSABLE by T4 — screen-space reflection cost, not triangle-driven.
t4_addressability.ShadowDepths_3.194: PARTIALLY addressable — shadow-depth of ALL species; T4 cuts the NON-Nanite species' shadow tris, but Conifer (Nanite) shadow depth is Nanite-managed. The non-Nanite vs Nanite split is UNMEASURED (per-species -game hide NOT AVAILABLE, forest_cost).
t4_addressability.Basepass_1.478_Prepass_0.074: PARTIALLY addressable — same non-Nanite/Nanite split, unmeasured.
t4_addressability.bound: T4-UNTOUCHABLE floor at forest_floor >= NaniteVisBuffer + LumenReflections = 3.50 ms of ~15.3. The reducible part (non-Nanite share of ShadowDepths+Basepass+Prepass) cannot be quantified without a per-species measurement.

finding: T4 rungs are NOT clearly the paying lever. The two biggest measured passes are ShadowDepths (3.19, mostly a SHADOW-DISTANCE / caster-count lever) and NaniteVisBuffer (2.20, Conifer/Nanite, untouchable by T4) + LumenReflections (1.30, a CULL / trace-distance lever). The measured dominant cost points at foliage-shadow-distance + cull distance, NOT (only) non-Nanite tri-reduction. The prior 'T4 does not pay' v3 inference was wrong about NaniteVisBuffer being negligible, but the CORRECTED picture still does not make non-Nanite rungs the main lever.
recommendation: Before the editor-risky rung build (which stalled on SpruceSub in D1a), rule the lever: (a) T4 rungs as planned (bounded, uncertain payoff), (b) pivot to the measured levers foliage-shadow-distance + cull (address ShadowDepths + LumenReflections directly), or (c) a per-species -game measurement first to attribute ShadowDepths/Basepass before committing to either.
